batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b TA Boult

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b IC Pandey

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b MM Sharma

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b R Ashwin

batting.name: KV Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

balls.text: What.a.knock. Century for Baz, take a bow, first of the season. Speared in full on the stumps, he jabs it to the covers and speeds off, Bravo is nearly run out. Warner has a shy at the stumps in vain. Baz waves his bat and sends the crowd into a tizzy before walking back to the hut

and again! Slippery short, bumpy ball, was that a slower one? Baz shapes up for the ramp and then picks it over the keeper with a reverse-slap of sorts, beats short third as well. He is toying with Boult. Races to 99.
low full toss on middle, Baz shuffles across, goes deep in the crease and ramps it over the keeper's head. Raina is seen whistling in the dug-out, goes all the way!

Boult takes an aim at the stumps, hits and catches Jaddu short. Baz is back on strike, though. Yorker, which is squirted back to the bowler. Baz sets off, Jaddu scarifies himself for the cause. Lightning throw from Boult

Dhoni picks out cover now. The CSK captain has done all the damage though. Good catch from Warner, for it was travelling at the rate of knots. Too full and outside off, Dhoni flays a drive. Warner hops up and cover and takes it around chest-height. Ouch, that must sting.
fifty for MS. Short and around off, he ventures deep in the crease and pulls it away between deep midwicket and deep square. He flashes a smile and Baz replicates
shortish again, Dhoni does not get hold of the pull. Sort of drags it to the leg side
back of a length and outside off, Dhoni swings and misses
on a length and on middle, Dhoni muscles it over midwicket for a one-bounce four

Bopara has fluffed a runout chance. Might have been a change of pace. Dhoni aims to push it back to the bowler, may have got an inside edge that rolls back to the bowler. Not sure if that was off the edge or off the pad. Baz was backing up far too much. Bopara does not hit
dug in short and just outside off, MS takes it from there and muscles a pull over the backward square leg umpire, who was ducking for cover
full and on the pads, whipped away to cow corner
Dhoni's love affair with SRH continues. This is even better - a monster blow. Dhoni runs down the track again and lofts it high and over long-on. Punches gloves with Baz
long-hop on the leg stump, Baz rocks back and pulls it away towards deep midwicket
punched down to long-on
Dhoni goes berserk again and so do the crowd. Uses his feet and pummels it over the midwicket boundary
slid through on middle and leg, cramped for room, played to the covers
What a strike from the helmet-less Dhoni! Tossed up, down the track and deposited it into the media box over long-on
dug in short and on middle and leg, turned to short fine and Dhoni keeps strike
yorker at the base of off, Baz toe-ends it to the off side and squeezes it out
Baz aims to back away, Bhuvi loses his cool as he slips it wide outside off. Past the tram-line and wide called
turned to mid-on for a quick single as this was straighter in line
on a length and sliding across off, Dhoni can't lay bat onto it
length ball on middle and off, Dhoni runs down the track and launches it over long-on. He mauled that. Not helicoptered, but the strong bottom hand comes to the fore
picked away off the pads backward of square leg. Dhoni sprints across for a couple
straighter in line, jerked away to the leg side off the inside section of the bat
low full toss, Dhoni squeezes it away behind point after flipping his wrists

dropped, Williamson the guilty party. Back of a length and on middle, Baz backs away and carves it in the air. Williamson rushes in from sweeper cover, dives forward, but can't cling onto it. In and out.
lowish full toss on the leg stump, glanced away to short fine
might have been the change of pace, Baz adjusts and steers it away to deep cover
banged in short and climbs onto Dhoni, who seeks a pull. Gets it high on the bat, the ball lands in front of long-on
pitched up and outside off, Dhoni opens his bat-face and drives it, but finds point again
on a length and outside off, he waits on it and guides it away to the left of a diving backward point. The man at third man gets across and cuts it off
Boult fires a yorker wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out and jabs it away to point again
length and wide outside off, Dhoni stays back and steers it to the man at point
low full toss outside off, Dhoni can't put that away. He looks to drive but can't connect with it
fuller and on off, Dhoni looks to jerk a drive, but has to settle with an inside edge back to the returning Boult
pitched up and outside off, inviting the drive. Baz throws his bat at it with no footwork, takes the inside edge, evades the stumps and runs away fine
good length outside off, driven between the covers and point
yorker from Bopara, MS digs it out

Raina walks off. Sharp work from KL Rahul at point, he had only one stump to aim at it and he lasers a direct hit. Back of a length and outside off as Raina takes a step out and punches it to point. He drifts off for a single, but is sent back. He pulls off a desperate dive,it ends in vain. Rahul moved to his right, dived and grabbed the ball even as it swerved away. He lost his balance but managed to hit the bullseye
too full and straight, whipped away through midwicket
straighter in line on middle, Raina waits on it and dabs it with soft hands to short third man
pushed through flat on middle and leg, worked to the leg side, to the right of the bowler. The pair look for a single but decide against it
Karn is rattled. Short and dragged down, Baz rocks back and mauls a pull over midwicket. Phew, I wish I had such fast hands
majectic, clean and effective. Tossed up, races down the track like a commuter with a train to catch. He extends his arms and hoists it over the bowler's head
Karn gives this more air on off, sliced in front of point
floated on the leg stump, down the track and whippily driven to long-on
shortish and outside off, Baz rocks back and cracks it away to long-off
too leg-stumpish from Ishant, Raina helps it over backward square. Bhuvi runs across from deep fine leg and keeps it to a couple
Ishant pulls his length back to test Baz. Mistimed pull, dragged towards fine leg
outragerous. Nope, its just Baz being Baz and Ishant being Ishant. Full toss on middle, Baz goes low and laps it up and over the keeper's head
another no-ball from Ishant. He is copping a pasting. Baz steps away, Ishant delivers a full toss outside off, sliced away behind point
Baz charges to his fifty in style. High-ish full toss, just on/below the waist line. He smashes in to the stands. Was that into the I,J,or the K stand?
Ishant goes round the wicket. Low full toss, reverse-lapped away to short third. Oh gee, another misfield and an extra run conceded
fuller and on middle and leg, Raina shuffles across and nurdles a single through midwicket. Eye-catching wristwork
slower length ball on middle, not a cuttable length. Yet Baz makes a bit of room and plays the stroke. Mis-hit [chopped] straight to the fielder at point
Raina steps way outside leg, Bhuvi is aware of it as he follows the batsman. Raina adjusts and steers it away towards deep cover
back of a length and on middle, Raina screams 'no' after turning it to midwicket
back of a length and outside off, Raina carves it away, uses the pace on it and punches it past a diving backward point
low full toss as Baz steps out, toe-ends it down to long-off

back of a length and on middle, punched in front of Rahul at mid-on. Raina calls for a quick single. Rahul comes in and flings a side-armed throw, but does not effect the direct-hit. A run-hustling Raina, slides and reaches the safety zone
dug in short and quick, top-of-off line, foils Baz's attempted cut. Chopped into the covers
Baz roars now. Tossed up on middle, he gets a good stride forward and sends it soaring over long-on
dragged short as Baz nips down the track, punched tamely back to the bowler
pushed through outside off, Baz reverse-sweeps and misses
short and wide outside off, that is showing a red rag to a raging bull. Baz rocks back and cuts it uppishly over the covers. Long-off runs across, slides and misses. Bhuvi's effort in vain
slid through on middle, punched off the back foot to long-on
near yorker from Bopara, Baz jams his bat down and survives
Raina eases forward and drives this length ball to long-on
late dab to short third as Boult comes into the picture. He loses his balance and flings a throw to the keeper. But Raina is quick enough and wins the race
back of a length and outside off, Baz shapes for a big blow but misses
low full toss, driven wide of the covers as Raina gets off the mark

Oh well, Smith is in trouble, gone by a long way. SRH have a wicket at long last, via a direct hit. Dibbly-dobbler on off, Baz waits on it before before chopping it down to short third. He takes off for a single, Smith is late to respond. He is not the best of runners between the wickets either. Boult (I guess) nails a direct hit to signal the doom of Smith. Fine, flat throw
darted flat and quick on the leg stump, Smith is struck on the pad, but this was easily snaking down leg
pitched further up, Baz hoists it over the covers. Long-off hunts it down
Karn gives this more air, worked in front of midwicket for a single
on the pads again, Baz employs finesse as opposed to power. Dinked to short fine
short on the leg stump, knocked behind square on the leg side
looped up on middle, Smith extends his arms and lifts it over long-on with great authority
low full toss as Ishant mis-directs the yorker, Baz lashes a drive over a leaping covers. Mid-off also had no chance to cut that off. This is an impressive start from CSK
similar length and outside off, Baz clears his front leg as he winds up. Swings and misses
Back of a length and on middle, Baz is down the track and clobbers it over long-on. CSK are a fast train here. Third free-hit put away
Ishant is rusty, another no-ball. Baz runs down the track, Ishant drags his length back outside off to defeat Baz. But he has overstepped, again. Big no-ball
back of a length and around off, dabbed to the left of the covers for a single
back of a length and moves away outside off, past the nevry waft of Smith
Smith has leathered that. On a length and an off, Smith punchily drives it to the long-off boundary. He is right to hold his pose and soak in that hit
nicely looped up, keeping Baz to a forward defence back to the bowler
straight roller on middle, Smith coaxes it in front of mid-on. They get a single by the time Karn collects the ball
Karn gives this some air, full on the stumps, bunted down to long-on
pushed through, blocked back to the bowler off an inside edge I guess
Baz has murdered that! Somebody call 100. Dropped short and the long-hop is dispatched away into one of the empty stands over deep square leg. How much power was packed in that pull?
tossed up on the leg stump, nudged in front of square off an inside edge
good length ball on off, Smith shows caution and blocks it to the covers

And Smith takes full toll of it. Too full and outside off as Ishant's attempted yorker goes awry, Smith carves it away, beating the dive of point. 'Boys in yellow, come out and play/You're gonna make them follow, lead the way/Say S-U-P-E-R-K-I-N-G-S'  blares in the background
banged in short and outside off, he half-ducks and half-ways out of the way
back of a length and outside off, Smith takes a step forward but does not meet with his signature short-arm pull. Beaten and that draws applause from Warner
on a length and moves away outside off, Smith hangs his bat out and the ball zips past the outside edge. Replays show that Ishant had rolled his fingers across that
yorker at the base of off, dug out in front of square off an inside edge
similar length and outside off, Baz goes for an almighty swing and misses. The umpire calls out Ishant for overstepping. A roar rings around MA Chidambaram stadium
back of a length and on off as Baz races down the track. Dragged to mid-off off the inside half of the bat. Baz persists with that come-what-may-I-will-attack approach
that's a freebie from Boult and Smith cashes in as he flicks it away to the right of short fine leg
veering onto the pads, whipped away through midwicket
very full and on middle, Baz gets a good stride forward and punches it on the up, over the bowler and beats mid-on to his left
Baz nips down the track, Boult pulls his length back a touch outside leg. He wants to thunk it out of MA Chidambaram stadium, but only meets with thin air
swerving in on the pads, Smith has looked scratchier than a pair of under-crackers. Misses the flick, off the pad and rolls in front of square
banged in short and on off, Smith hangs back and fends it in front of the bowler
pitched further up and on off - right in the driving zone - Baz flays it away to mid-off. Bhuvi aimed to intercept the ball with his left boot, but the man at mid-off has it covered
yorker from Bhuvi, right on the money. Baz can only toe-end the attempted drive back to Bhuvi
Bhuvi tries to mix things up, slower ball down leg
good length ball, he comes forward and blocks it to the off side
bazooka blow! Baz runs down the track, manufactures a length back and launches it over deep midwicket. What fast hands and foot work

these are bouns runs for CSK. Inswinger from Bhuvi, Smith hangs back and gets an inside-edge onto the pad. The ball dribbles in front of the covers. The pair take off for a single, Bhuvi gets to the ball, misses the direct hit and concedes four via overthrows. Mid-off and mid-on collided and were felled to the floor. The ball runs away to the long-on boundary
Bhuvi invests in an outswinger outside off, Smith flashes and misses. Past the tram-line
on a good length and curves in on off, Smith is hit high on the bat, defended to the off side

Boult's lbw appeal amounts to nothing. This was on a length and swings in sharply on off, Baz aims to drive but is beaten as he is hit just above the knee-roll. Height may have been a factor there. Oh no, it was close. No signs of an inside snick as well
yorker length and swerves back in again, no room at all for Smith, who jabs his bat down and gets an inside edge to short fine
on a good length, swings back in on the leg stump. Smith does not read the movement and is struck on the pad
marginally back of a length and just a shade outside off, Baz bunts it to mid-off and sets off for a speedy single. His partner reciprocated well  too
on a length and wide outside off, Baz swings and gets beaten there
fetch that, Mr.Boult, says Baz. Width on offer outside off, overpitched as well. Baz lashes a drive over cover-point, sends it screaming away to the fence
Boult gets some gentle swing but drifts it down leg. Baz seeks to glance it away but only meets with thin air
Bhuvi drags his length back, Smith is crease-bound and squirts it to the leg side off an inside edge
fullish and homing in on off, he comes forward and presses it back to the bowler
fuller and Bhuvi sustains the inward movement. Smith wants to flick it to leg again, gets an leading edge that evades the covers and runs away to the boundary. Not convincing, never mind says Smith
good length and shapes back in on off, Smith does not meet with the flick. Wears it on the pad
fullish and outside off with a hint of away swing and extra bounce to add to it. Hits high on the bat,  defended tentatively to the covers
pitched up and sliding across Smith, who aims for a flashy drive and gets beaten soundly
Williamson backs away a touch, Mohit follows him with tight yorker, which is bunted towards long-off. CSK score their second victory, this one more emphatic than the first

clean strike from Williamson. Too little and too late, though. Length ball outside off, Williamson extends his arms and hoists it over long-off. Even Baz can't propel himself upward and intercept it. Should Williamson have batted up the order?
another of those slower ones on middle and leg, from the back of the hand, tickled to short fine
yorker at the base of the leg stump, he backs away and squeezes it out to the off side
dug in short and on middle, he clears his front leg, semi slogs, semi pulls it away to cow corner
back of a length and outside off, cut late to point

Raina completes a brilliant catch and Dhoni applauds, he now tops the list of match catches in the IPL. Most runs, most catches, Mr.IPL. Slower length ball on middle, Karn steps away a touch and slices it in the air. Raina runs to his right from long-off dives, tumbles and plucks it. Bravo has his hands aloft in joy
off-speed ball outside off, Kane Williamson can't manufacture his own pace. Punched down to long-on, not much power behind that, though
dug in short and climbs alarmingly, Karn takes his eyes off the ball and mis-times the pull over square leg
slower short ball on off, does not come onto Williamson. Mit-hit pull over midwicket
Karn rides the bounce of this short one outside off and steers it straight to short third
slower length ball on middle, lashed down to Raina at long-off
Nehra slides this outside off, Karn wants to smash it from Chepauk to Tambaram. But only meets it with thin air. Change of pace, I reckon
lowish full toss outside off, swept away for a single
back of a length and outside off, carved away through the covers
yorker from Nehra, dug out by Williamson. As Monga says, "he still has it in him"
fuller and on middle and leg, he aims to force it away to the leg side. Only manages an inside edge
Nehra darts a full toss down leg
on a back of a length and on off, stops on the batsman. Chipped in front of long-off. Baz (who else?) swoops in on the ball like a tiger and keeps it to a single
full and sliding across off, past the tram-line and that's another wide. Williamson swings and misses
slower yorker from Bravo, jabbed down to long-on
pitched and outside off, he throws his bat at it and slices it to deep third man

Yorker from Bravo, defeats Bopara. He breaks into a jig - not sure if that's the 'Chaka Chaka dance' but nice moves, man. Fired in, Bopara can't dig it out, it slides under his bat to cannon into middle. It gets knocked back.
fullish and outside off, sliced away to backward point
slower cutter on off - a Bravo special - he waits for it to arrive, opens his bat-face and dinks it behind point
Williamson backs away outside leg, Bravo is alert and sprays it on the pad. Misses the flick and they cross over for a leg bye
seeing Williamson back away, Bravo boings a short ball outside off to fox Williamson, who can't get bat onto it. Wide called for height
Williamson is down the track, Jaddu shortens his length. Jerked away to the off-side. He hardly timed that
pushed through, sliced away over the covers
tossed up, Bopara comes down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and lifts it over long-off
good strike from Bopara. He goes inside-out over the covers. Stand and deliver
slid through on middle and leg, punched down to long-on
pushed through outside off, some turn as well. Nudged to short third, fumble there and Williamson takes two
fraction back of a length and outside off, steered away to deep third man, Williamson off the mark

Warner has holed out to deep midwicket, Smith leaps near the boundary and completes a sharp catch. Short and on the leg stump as Warner backs away and Ishwar follows him. Warner got a good chunk of wood on the pull, but  came second to Smith. Well, this means that Williamson will have a bat after all
Warner reaches his fifty. He sits back, sizes up this short ball and sends it over midwicket
Ishwar bangs it short and wide outside off, Warner waits for an age, then guides it between backward point and short third man
dug in short and wide outside off as Bopara comes down the track. Sliced towards sweeper cover
back of a length and outside off as Ishwar catches Warner moving around the crease. Slapped away through the covers
97.1ks, slid through on middle and leg, punched down to long-on, he was cramped for room there. Ash has tightened the screws: 4-0-22-1
on the leg stump, paddled down to short fine
tossed up outside off, he was too early into the sweep and is beaten in flight and turn as well
darted quicker on the leg stump, Bopara hunts for a reverse- sweep and misses
flat and quick, pulled away to the leg side
fired flat on middle and leg, Warner goes for switch-hit but misses as he is hit on the pad
dug in shortish and outside off, does not climb much, though. Allowing Bopara to pull it away through midwicket. Jaddu, the off-side sweeper runs across, slides and keeps it down to a couple
dug in short and rises on middle, Warner stays back and clubs it over to Bravo at long-on
fiery short ball, rushes onto Warner, who is beaten on the pull. He is socked on the grille of the helmet. Warner is okay, though, he is a tough nut. He removes the helmet and takes a breather
short and wide outside off, slap-pulled down to long-on. Not all that well-timed too
back of a length and on middle and leg, Bopara hangs back and turns it to midwicket
back of a length and outside off, he wants to cut it away. He can only splice it in the air. Bravo rushes in from mid-off, tumbles forward but it does not stick
he goes low and paddles it round the corner for a single
pushed through outside off and he gets turn, the batsman has his fishing rod out and gets beaten
darted short, half pulled, half worked to the leg side

The pressure gets the better of Ojha. This was a top spinner from Ashwin - not the offbreak. Ojha runs down the track but mis-hits the lofted stroke, holes out to long-off. Mohit follows the ball, watches it all along and pouches it safely
darted outside leg, helped away backward of square leg with a pull
pushed through on middle and leg, turned through midwicket. They earn a couple by the time Ashwin gets to the ball
back of a length and on middle, he backs away and slices it past the covers for a couple of runs
another of the slower ones from Bravo's armour, scuttles low as well. Warner does well to adjust and punch it to long-off
back of a length off-speed ball outside off, Warner wants to thump it through the off side but ends up beaten
forced down the ground  for a couple
back of a length and pushed too wide outside off, I'm afraid

poor mix-up, poor throw, poor cricket all-round. Back of a length and outside off, Warner reaches out and slashes it away to the covers. The fielder flings a throw at Bravo, there is a communication between the wickets, Warner is sent back. Bravo collects the throw and instead of relaying to the keeper, waywardly throws towards third man, I guess. Warner slides and survives
nearly slapped back to the bowler! Shortish and outside off, flat-batted away towards long-on. Bravo stretches his left hand but it does not stick
fast full toss on middle and leg, that is asking for trouble. Thumped away over midwicket
quicker from Ash, Ojha comes down the track and slices it in front of point. Jaddu shows off his reflexes and cuts it to a couple
dragged short and wide outside off, pulled strongly away to the leg side
tossed up, he aims for a slog-sweep, gets an inside-edge that sneaks away fine
looped up on middle now, Ojha aims to go big and gets an inside edge onto the pad
darted quick on the pads at 97ks, he does not get hold of the flick.
Ojha looks to make room, Bravo darts it on the pads of Ojha, who does not get hold of the flick, wearing in on the pad
slower, back of a length and outside off, flat-batted down the track to long-off
full and wide outside off, Warner has an almighty swing at it and his head falls away. Sliced up and over backward point, towards square third man
veering onto the pads of Ohja, glanced to fine leg
wide line outside off, he reaches out and squeezes it to deep cover
back of a length and outside off, flashed to the right of the covers. Jaddu mops it up in the deep
chipped in front of long-on. They decide not to take on Jaddu's arm. Only a single
Ash generates some extra bounce. Warner goes for a reverse-sweep and is beaten
darted outside leg, he goes for a slog-sweep, takes the pad
Ash gets some spin, shortish as well. Ojha rides it towards point
slid through short on off, semi pulled, semi shovelled to deep midwicket
Ash lands this on off and gets it to spin away, dabbed behind point
low full toss on the leg stump, Warner's glance does not come to pass. Brushes the pad, beats Dhoni and sneaks away very fine
Warner backs away, Ishwar slides this short ball outside leg. Not called a wide. Hmm, this game has something for the bowlers as well
He meets this back-of-a-length ball with an open face, gets on top of the bounce and nudges it behind point
back of a length and on the hips, misses the flick. Off the pad and runs away behind square on the off-side
shortish and on middle, he stays back and steers it straight to short third
Hello, Ishwar says Warner. Banged in short and outside off - soft as wax. Sits up to be hit. Warner drums a pull over midwicket

Mohit is pretty good with these slippery back-of-the-hand slower ones. This consumes Rahul. He aims to swipe it away to the leg side. He does not lay bat onto it, Mohit hits the stumps. Deflected off the pads and onto the stumps

Mohit goes up for a caught-behind shout and so does Dhoni, umpire Illingworth shakes his head. Fuller and teasing Rahul outside off, he aims to dab it towards third man but misses. The sound came from the bat brushing the pad. Good call
on a good length and outside off, stops on Warner, who adjusts and taps it down the ground
wide line outside off, pushed towards deep cover

Jadeja leaps, gets  hand to it and parries it over the boundary. Dragged short, but again Mohit lacks pace to test Warner. He switches onto the back foot and pulls it in the air. Jadu stretches his left hand and lobs it over. Difficult chance
Mohit deceives Warner. Short slow ball outside off. Warner is early into the pull and is bested by Mohit
on a fullish length and outside off, sticks in the pitch to rob all the timing from Rahul's drive. Sliced to the left of covers
fuller and slanting away outside off, Rahul looks to have a crack at it. But reins in his impulse and ignores it for MS
back of a length and outside off, the extra lift beats the attempted cut

Nehra does well to claim the outside edge of Rahul, but it dies down in front of Ash at first slip. Sliding across off, lures Rahul into a nervy push and edges it, Ash dives forward and parries it away. Might have been a cutter
back of a length and outside off, flayed to cover-point. Can't beat Baz
fuller on middle and leg, whipped away through midwicket
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, slashed over point. There is protection in the deep, though
banged in short and rises on Rahul, who rolls his wrists and controls a pull behind square leg

Mohit strikes! The slower ball works for Mohit. Too full and wide outside off, Dhawan, perhaps, looks to loft-drive it over the infield. But ends up slicing it to Jaddu at backward point. Undone by the slow off-cutter
back of a length and rises on off, Warner wants to force it through the off side, but has to settle with an inside edge that sneaks away to the leg side
he meets this length ball outside off with an open face and dabs it away in front of point
Dhawan goes bang! Mohit tests him with a short ball, not much pace on it. He rocks back and thwacks a pull over midwicket
fuller and on middle and leg, punched down the ground
Nehra wears a wry smile on his face, Raina shakes his head. Back of a length and outside off, Dhawan eases it away to the right of backward point. His dive has been rendered futile
on a fuller length and on middle, punched past the outstretched left hand of Nehra to long-on
back of a length and outside off, down the track and slapped away towards deep cover again
picked away off the hips, behind square on the leg side
short and wide outside off, Dhawan camps on the back foot and flashes a cut to the off-side sweeper
back of a length and outside off, forced down the ground, past the dive of Mohit Sharma
shortish and outside off as Dhawan chips down the track. On the up and slapped away to Baz at the covers
back of a length and outside off again, Dhawan stands up tall and dabs it towards cover-point via an open face
back of a length and outside off, Dhawan hangs back and attacks it. The ball lands in front of Raina at point. Did not punch that as well as he had done earlier
short, parcelled up and dispatched. Short and on the hips, Dhawan rocks back and pulls it away over square leg. He has gotten better against the short stuff
back of a length and outside off, punchily driven to the covers, straight to the fielder
good length and ball and moving away with angle outside off, guided away to third man
overpitched and outside off, Dhawan eases into a drive and sends it to the right of his Delhi-mate. Mid-off is defeated as well
good length angling away outside off, Dhawan glides it to point via an open face
back of a length, comes in a touch on off. Dhawan is crease-bound as he gets an inside edge onto the pad
crunched! Back of a length and outside off, Dhawan stands tall and balanced as he gets on top of the bounce and punches it beautifully past the covers. The fielder puts in a chase, ends it vain
banged in short and directed at the chest of Warner, who controls a pull and sends it over backward square leg
